title: BreastUS-CAD: frozen, pre-registered single-shot external validation of a breast ultrasound benign/malignant classifier, with deployment-oriented follow-up studies and an independent audit trail
description:
Code, protocols, results and audit trail of BreastUS-CAD; frozen model weights on Hugging Face.

Research prototype — not a medical device. A ViT-B/16 classifier trained on the public BUS-BRA dataset with the official patient-level five-fold splits, frozen (git tag frozen-v1) and validated single-shot on four external cohorts (BrEaST, Curated BUSI, GDPH, SYSUCC) under an internally version-controlled pre-registered protocol (data/external_protocol.md + 4 amendments), followed by pre-registered deployment-oriented studies (site-specific recalibration, ensemble-disagreement abstention, domain-pretrained backbone, leave-one-cohort-out multi-source training), an independent adversarial audit (docs/AUDIT_2026-09-06.md), two independent re-audits (docs/AUDIT2_claude_2026-09-11.md, docs/AUDIT2_astra_2026-09-11.md), the item-by-item responses (docs/AUDIT_RESPONSE_2026-09-06.md, docs/AUDIT2_RESPONSE.md), and post-hoc analyses quantifying the disclosed biases. The result tables in RESULTS.md recompute from the committed CSV/JSON artifacts (wandb-derived and latency numbers do not). The internal reference numbers describe one held-out checkpoint per image, not the deployed ensemble.

Version 1.1-audited (2026-09-12) supersedes 1.0-audited: corrections per the two re-audits (predictor labelling of the internal reference, the threshold rule as implemented, wording of the post-hoc analyses, false-negative and reader-information statements, provenance statements synchronised after the v1.0 deposition), two new post-hoc analyses, an overwrite guard in the external-validation script, and a self-describing archive (.git-commit holds the archived commit). Erratum for version 1.0-audited: the v1.0 archive's embedded docs/PROVENANCE.md §7, README.md and CITATION.cff describe the archive as commit 1f196a9 with SHA-256 fcd270a5… and "DOI pending"; the deposited file is in fact the archive of commit fa193a8 (verified bit-identical by both re-audits) and those embedded lines predate the tag re-point. Model checkpoints are not in this archive: frozen-v1 weights (repo root) and v2 research checkpoints (v2/) are on Hugging Face with SHA-256 checksums in models/CHECKSUMS.txt. Pre-registration was internal and not externally time-stamped before this deposition; see docs/PROVENANCE.md.
